# Works on PHP 7.4

`W17` · Coding rule

PHP 7.4 + Laravel 5.3.31: no ?->, match, named args, promoted constructor properties, union/mixed, attributes; no $request->validate(), API Resources, Http:: client, array-callable routes, Route::view
